children: Gloo Holdings reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $46.6 million, up 188% year-over-year, beating guidance and analyst consensus. The company narrowed its net loss to $21.2 million and improved Adjusted EBITDA sequentially to negative $8.3 million, its third consecutive quarter of improvement. Gloo raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $200 million and reiterated expectations to reach Adjusted EBITDA profitability in Q4 2026.
Total revenue: $46.6 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026, representing 188% growth versus the prior-year period and above guidance of $44.0 million.
Six-month total revenue: $88.1 million for the six months ended July 31, 2026 (compared with $28.5 million for the six months ended July 31, 2025).
Operating loss: $(20.5) million for the quarter (operating loss of $(39.2) million for the six months).
Net loss: $(21.2) million for the quarter, narrowed from a net loss of $(44.1) million in Q2 2025; six-month net loss was $(38.2) million.
Adjusted EBITDA: $(8.3) million for the quarter (improved from prior periods) and the company expects to approach break-even in Q3 2026 and achieve Adjusted EBITDA profitability in Q4 2026.
Enterprise traction: Over 30 customers now generate $1M+ in annual contract value, and the company reached its first customer exceeding $10M in annual contract value during the quarter.

Vertical expansion: Universities are an emerging growth vertical with more than forty universities served, including Indiana Wesleyan University, Jessup University, University of Northwestern and Whitworth University.

M&A and integration: Since its public debut, Gloo announced five strategic acquisitions and completed the acquisition of Enterprisemarketdesk in Q2; it also completed the remaining stake acquisition in Midwestern and closed the Cedarstone acquisition in August 2026 to add capabilities and specialized expertise.
Cross-platform adoption: Increasing cross-selling across Gloo's platform and Capital Partners, with many large customers adopting solutions from multiple business units.

AI initiatives: Expanded Applied AI capabilities including the launch of Gloo Code within Gloo AI Studio and preparations for a Gloo AI Hackathon to accelerate applied AI adoption across the faith and flourishing ecosystem.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Gloo Holdings posts Q2 revenue up 188% to $46.6M, narrows net loss; raises FY26 revenue guide to $200M
